transition.meaning: Opaque schema-transition token re-recording the four superseded predecessors as stale in the v4 workspace lineage. It maps existing history and does not identify or create a reviewer.

owner.meaning: Opaque token for the 2026-09-27 owner batch approval of the 90 batch-2 directory/registry listing records. It identifies the review action only; it is not authentication or an authority.

plannedDecisions.note: Owner batch approval recorded per record through npm run evidence:review.
